mapper.insert: insert into material(name, teacher_name, teacher_id, size, course_id, folder_id, path, create_time) values (#{name}, #{teacherName}, #{teacherId}, #{size}, #{courseId}, #{folderId}, #{path}, #{createTime, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP})
mapper.update: update material set name = #{name}, teacher_name = #{teacherName}, teacher_id = #{teacherId}, size = #{size}, course_id = #{courseId}, folder_id = #{folderId}, path = #{path}, create_time = #{createTime, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} where id = #{id}
